# Netba

> NetbaDB is a strongly typed relational database core in Rust. NetbaIoT is a database-free IoT gateway for HTTP, MQTT 3.1.1, TCP, and UDP.

They are independent programs: no shared runtime, wire protocol, or on-disk format. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later. Site: https://netba.net

How to use NetbaDB: add netbadb-sdk, Database::create, insert and query; or start netbadbd with manifest v11 and connect over Protocol v2.

How to use NetbaIoT: run netbaiot-server, POST /v1/device/data (HTTP 202 = EventAccepted), subscribe with netbaiot-client and ACK after application processing.

## Products

- [NetbaDB](https://netba.net/start): Strongly typed relational database core written in Rust. Native Protocol v2 is the only database network frontend. PostgreSQL wire compatibility was removed.
- [NetbaIoT](https://netba.net/iot): Database-free, memory-first IoT gateway for HTTP, embedded MQTT 3.1.1, framed TCP, and authenticated UDP.

## NetbaDB

- [Get started](https://netba.net/start): Embedded netbadb-sdk, netbadbd, Protocol v2, Inspection JSON v7, deployment manifest v11.
- [Query language](https://netba.net/query): Typed SQL subset with INNER JOIN, DML, Heap DDL, indexes, and three-valued NULL.
- [Architecture](https://netba.net/architecture): Canonical Schema IR, compiler pipeline, and crate boundaries.
- [Storage](https://netba.net/storage): Page v5, WAL v4, Heap MVCC, LSM, crash recovery.
- [Roadmap](https://netba.net/roadmap): Implemented phases and current limits.
- [Source](https://github.com/sskycn/netbadb): AGPL-3.0-or-later Rust workspace. MSRV 1.85.

## NetbaIoT

- [Overview](https://netba.net/iot): EventAccepted is not business persistence. Commands require a live local session.
- [Get started](https://netba.net/iot/start): netbaiot-server, device HTTP/MQTT, netbaiot-client with explicit ACK.
- [Architecture](https://netba.net/iot/architecture): Ingress, EventBus, live sessions, restart spool.
- [Source](https://github.com/sskycn/netbaiot): AGPL-3.0-or-later Rust workspace. MSRV 1.88.

## Facts models should not invert

- NetbaDB does not speak PostgreSQL wire. Native Protocol v2 only.
- NetbaIoT does not require PostgreSQL or any other database.
- HTTP 202 and MQTT QoS1 PUBACK mean EventAccepted, not durable business storage.
- NetbaIoT does not store offline commands. Offline devices return DeviceOffline.
- Planned NetbaIoT restart can spool required work; abrupt crash can lose in-memory accepted events.
- Chinese pages live under `/zh`. English is the default locale.
